prerequisites: The student has already followed first semester courses in phase 1 or comparable training.

learning_outcomes.text: The student is able to formulate a clear problem statement, objective, and assignment for electronic or ICT systems in consultation with stakeholders.
He/she substantiates the assignment through analysis and research.
The student is able to develop an electronic or ICT system for a proof of concept or service that meets a number of conditions.
He/she is able to realize a relevant implementation within the set conditions. He/she justifies the choices made for the different components.
The student delivers a working proof of concept solution or service.
The solution is a complete and correct implementation of established requirements. He/she verifies and validates the product or service against the stated requirements.
He/she documents the realization process.
The student makes the technological system function in its application context or working environment.
He/she compiles a documentation bundle with a view to reproducing and maintaining it.
The student communicates purposefully about the assignment using the main current communication forms and techniques.
He/she is able to clearly summarize the different aspects of his project, articulate them orally and in writing, and present them visually.
The student can offer relevant advice to third parties in relation to his/her design and the associated process. This for a wide variety of stakeholders and potential target groups.
The student has insight into his/her own entrepreneurial ability.
He/she demonstrates an entrepreneurial attitude including initiative, out-of-the-box thinking, perseverance, design thinking, critical thinking, self-knowledge, and action orientation.
He/she takes into account the commercial feasibility of his project.
The student strives for quality work in terms of project and performance management. He/she performs his/her own tasks as independently as possible and works solution-oriented.
He/she directs, evaluates, and optimizes his/her own effectiveness. He/she adjusts based on feedback.
He/she approaches assignments in a project-based manner and respects the planning and budgetary context and adjusts if necessary.
He/she functions in a team-oriented and entrepreneurial manner.
The student adopts a constructive attitude as an expert member of a (project) team with an eye on his/her own (future) role and responsibility within a company or organization.
He/she thinks in an international and digital working environment.

syllabus_topics: Project-dependent and multidisciplinary content with aspects related to various course units of the program
Independent project development during lab sessions
Project proposal approval by the supervising lecturer
Presentation and defense of project results
assessment_rules: Evaluation is partial or continuous with an exam during the examination period. The grading scale is 1-20. Resit arrangements are identical to the first attempt. There are no partial transfers for this course.
